Question: Let \(M\) be the least common multiple of all the integers \(10\) through \(30,\) inclusive. Let \(N\) be the least common multiple of \(M,\) \(32,\) \(33,\) \(34,\) \(35,\) \(36,\) \(37,\) \(38,\) \(39,\) and \(40.\) What is the value of \(\dfrac{N}{M}?\)
